prompt:
Add a program-sharing feature to this Next.js fitness app, wiring up three new API routes. Fetch program data with the existing server action `getProgramBySlug(slug)` from `@/features/programs/actions/get-program-by-slug.action` (returns the program or null; 404 when null).

1. `app/api/programs/[slug]/share/route.ts` (GET): return JSON with the program's shareable metadata: `{ title, description, level, exerciseCount, url }` where url is `/programs/<slug>`.
2. `app/api/programs/[slug]/share/preview/route.ts` (GET): return an HTML preview card (Content-Type: text/html) for the program, showing its title, description, level, and a link to the program page. Style the preview so it looks visually consistent with how programs are presented elsewhere in the app.
3. `app/api/og/programs/[slug]/route.tsx`: a social share image using `next/og` `ImageResponse`, showing the program title and level with branding consistent with the app.

Make the three routes coherent and production-quality, and keep the preview and the OG image visually consistent with the rest of the app's program UI.
